meta.name: intel-discipline-advisor
meta.description: Triage a competitive or market question into the right intelligence disciplines, cadence, and executing skill. Use when you know something needs researching but not which channel to run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分流市场疑问到正确的研究路径
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常面对研究问题却不确定该用哪个方法和技能。
copy.tagline_en: Route a competitive or market question to the right research path.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face research questions but aren't sure which skill to use.

howto.what: 它会用三个逐步提问帮你把问题归类,再给出编号推荐:每条推荐列出该用的情报学科组合(如OSINT、FININT)、复查节奏、执行技能与产出物,并解释选择原因,顺便教你以后自己判断。
howto.when: 当你表示要研究某个竞品或市场问题、但不确定从哪条情报渠道入手时触发。

say.text: 我怀疑竞品在偷偷搞大动作,但不知道先查什么。
say.note: 它会从问题1开始引导你分类。

say.text: 我只有每季度4小时做竞品情报,该怎么分配?
say.note: 它会问约束,再按你的时间预算推荐节奏。

say.text: 两个对手工程师刚关注了我们CTO,意味着什么?
say.note: 它会把已发现的信号当作起点来验证。

howto.what_en: It runs a 3-question adaptive triage and returns numbered recommendations naming which intelligence disciplines (e.g. OSINT, FININT), cadence, executing skill and artifact each option needs, explaining the why so you learn the mapping.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say you need to research a competitor or market question but don't know which intelligence channel to run.

say_en.text: I suspect a competitor is up to something but don't know where to look first.
I only have 4 hours this quarter for competitive intel — where should they go?
say_en.note: Asks constraints and matches cadence to your budget.

say_en.text: Two rival engineers just followed our CTO — what does that mean?
say_en.note: Treats that signal as a head start for corroboration.
